applies_to: Future delegated finite packets only; does not change the coordinating chat or global settings
orchestrator: Root review/integration; no permanent whole-package middle coordinator, local worker timer or busy polling

policy.goal: Minimize expected complete-task cost, including context, reasoning/output, retries and required reviews; preserve acceptance quality.
policy.cheap_work: Luna low for deterministic records, Luna medium for released fixtures/exact mechanical substeps, Sol low for narrowly specified technical leaves, Sol medium for ordinary code. Cheap assistance performs no contract or acceptance adjudication.
policy.strong_work: Sol high only for already substantive unresolved joins/contract/ABI/authority/lifecycle/host work; frozen disjoint leaf work can be a cheaper finite subpacket. Astra only required critical/expert stages.
policy.review: Risk-matched finite independent review, with requirements/raw witness/source pins and no implementer verdicts; reuse unchanged accepted evidence at proved scope and combine only compatible released slices. Root retains acceptance and Git.
policy.context: No full-history fork by default. Supply exact finite task/files/contract/witness/owner inputs; read long source selectively and return compact changed-source/command/negative/result receipts.
policy.failure: A failed product check is not automatically a model failure. Reuse active handles, diagnose once within finite scope, then escalate actual uncertainty; no blind repeated whole-task attempts.
policy.effort: No xhigh/max/Ultra or Pro by habit. Only select supported settings; hidden or unsupported tier/mode/token controls are not configured by this file.
policy.freshness: Recheck actual dispatcher availability, per-slice risks and official prices before cost-sensitive dispatch. Never silently substitute an unsupported model.
policy.guards: Do not use cheap model choice to lift owner, security-review, human HOLD, original runtime/consumer/installed/retirement or execution_authorized=false gates.

api_price_comparison_only.units: USD per 1M text tokens, Standard short context; not Codex subscription usage, actual account bill or a Can savings forecast
